2610.07791.title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
2610.07791.paper_summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.
2610.07791.paper_summary_zh: 虛幻模式感知是一種已被充分記錄的人類認知傾向，指的是在實際隨機的數據中推斷有意義的關係。這種傾向，常被描述為「連接不存在的點」，可能導致系統性的推理錯誤。本文探討大型語言模型（LLMs）是否展現這種感知傾向，這可能在下游應用中導致系統性錯誤。據我們所知，這項工作是首次系統性研究LLMs中的虛幻模式感知，將經典心理學範式應用於三個任務，並與人類行為進行直接的實證比較。我們發現LLMs經常表現出比人類更強的虛幻模式感知。特別是，模型傾向於將頻繁的正面特徵過度關聯於主要群體或大型組織，並顯示出從模糊事件中構建因果敘事的增加傾向。為了揭示這些行為背後的機制，我們開發了一個基於稀疏自編碼器（SAEs）的特徵可解釋性框架來分析內部表徵。我們的結果顯示，整體頻率感知和分析性認知取向與虛幻感知的出現相關聯。這些發現突顯了一種先前未被充分探索的類似認知的幻覺，這可能影響LLM推理的可靠性。代碼可在 https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory 獲得。
